Author: frigidgear
Name: VanaCoreXIV
Punchline: FOV, UI, game graphics, optional ReShade bridge.
Description: Control panel for FFXIV: camera, UI scales, system graphics, presets, ReShade bridge.

Dalamud plugin for FFXIV: FOV/zoom, nameplates, chat/UI scale, game SystemConfig graphics, presets, performance overlays. ReShade companion for post-process. Not a 1:1 FFXI VanaCore port — built for FFXIV/Dalamud.
